description: Test whether ADIRF's helix has the 11/3 periodicity of lipid-binding amphipathic helices or the 3.5-residue coiled-coil periodicity
code:
import requests, numpy as np, pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
ADIRF="MASKGLQDLKQQVEGTAQEAVSAAGAAAQQVVDQATEAGQKAMDQLAKTTQETIDKTANQASDTFSGIGKKFGLLK"
eis=dict(A=0.62,R=-2.53,N=-0.78,D=-0.90,C=0.29,Q=-0.85,E=-0.74,G=0.48,H=-0.40,I=1.38,L=1.06,
K=-1.50,M=0.64,F=1.19,P=0.12,S=-0.18,T=-0.05,W=0.81,Y=0.26,V=1.08)
def mu(s,d):
    a=np.deg2rad(d*np.arange(len(s))); h=np.array([eis.get(x,0) for x in s])
    return float(np.sqrt((h*np.cos(a)).sum()**2+(h*np.sin(a)).sum()**2)/len(s))
def mu_mean(s,d,W=18):
    return float(np.mean([mu(s[i:i+W],d) for i in range(len(s)-W+1)])) if len(s)>=W else np.nan

def up(acc, lo=None, hi=None):
    s=requests.get(f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{acc}.fasta",timeout=60).text
    s="".join(s.split("\n")[1:])
    return s[(lo-1 if lo else 0):(hi if hi else len(s))]

panel={
 # amphipathic-helix lipid/membrane binders (11/3 class, ~98-99 deg/res expected)
 "SNCA 1-95 (alpha-synuclein)":        (up("P37840",1,95),"amphipathic lipid binder"),
 "APOA1 66-243 (helix repeats)":       (up("P02647",66,243),"amphipathic lipid binder"),
 "APOC3 21-99":                        (up("P02656",21,99),"amphipathic lipid binder"),
 "APOE 150-290":                       (up("P02649",150,290),"amphipathic lipid binder"),
 "PLIN3 (TIP47) 100-200":              (up("O60664",100,200),"amphipathic lipid binder"),
 "PLIN2 (ADRP) 100-200":               (up("Q99541",100,200),"amphipathic lipid binder"),
 "HILPDA (full, 63 aa)":               (up("Q9Y5L4"),"amphipathic lipid binder"),
 # coiled coils (3.5 res/turn, ~102.9 deg/res expected)
 "TPM1 (tropomyosin, coiled coil)":    (up("P09493"),"coiled coil"),
 "GCN4-like: JUN 253-315 (bZIP CC)":   (up("P05412",253,315),"coiled coil"),
 "MYH7 1100-1300 (myosin rod CC)":     (up("P12883",1100,1300),"coiled coil"),
 # globular helical bundle control
 "MB (myoglobin, globular bundle)":    (up("P02144"),"globular helix bundle"),
 "HBB (globin)":                       (up("P68871"),"globular helix bundle"),
}
panel["ADIRF (full, 76 aa)"]=(ADIRF,"ADIRF (query)")
panel["ADIRF 20-55 (core helix)"]=(ADIRF[19:55],"ADIRF (query)")

deltas=np.arange(85,116,0.25)
rows=[]; curves={}
for name,(s,cls) in panel.items():
    c=np.array([mu_mean(s,d) for d in deltas]); curves[name]=c
    rows.append(dict(region=name, cls=cls, L=len(s), best_delta=float(deltas[np.nanargmax(c)]),
                     res_per_turn=360/float(deltas[np.nanargmax(c)]), muH_at_best=float(np.nanmax(c)),
                     muH_100=mu_mean(s,100.0)))
res=pd.DataFrame(rows).sort_values(["cls","region"])
print("Periodicity that maximises the mean Eisenberg hydrophobic moment (18-residue windows)")
print("11/3 amphipathic class expectation ~98.2 deg/res (3.67 res/turn); coiled coil ~102.9 (3.5)\n")
print(res.round(3).to_string(index=False))
print("\nGroup means:")
print(res.groupby("cls")[["best_delta","res_per_turn","muH_at_best","muH_100"]].mean().round(3).to_string())
res.to_csv("/agent/jobs/7101df4b-f637-4c64-a448-cb0dfb4eb46e/provenance/adirf_helix_periodicity.csv",index=False)

fig,ax=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(14,5.6))
colmap={"amphipathic lipid binder":"#2f855a","coiled coil":"#2b6cb0","globular helix bundle":"#718096","ADIRF (query)":"#dd6b20"}
for name,(s,cls) in panel.items():
    ax[0].plot(deltas,curves[name],color=colmap[cls],lw=3 if cls=="ADIRF (query)" else 1.3,
               alpha=1 if cls=="ADIRF (query)" else .65,
               label=name if cls=="ADIRF (query)" else None)
for cls,c in colmap.items():
    ax[0].plot([],[],color=c,lw=2,label=cls)
ax[0].axvline(98.2,ls='--',c='#2f855a',alpha=.7); ax[0].text(98.4,0.015,'11/3 helix\n98.2°',color='#2f855a',fontsize=8)
ax[0].axvline(102.9,ls='--',c='#2b6cb0',alpha=.7); ax[0].text(103.1,0.015,'coiled coil\n102.9°',color='#2b6cb0',fontsize=8)
ax[0].set_xlabel('rotation per residue (degrees)'); ax[0].set_ylabel('mean Eisenberg <$\\mu_H$>, 18-residue windows')
ax[0].set_title('ADIRF peaks at the 11/3 periodicity of lipid-binding\namphipathic helices, not at the coiled-coil periodicity',fontsize=11)
ax[0].legend(fontsize=8,loc='upper right'); ax[0].grid(alpha=.25)

# helical wheel of ADIRF 31-48, the maximum-moment window
seg=ADIRF[30:48]; ang=np.deg2rad(100*np.arange(len(seg)))
ax[1].set_aspect('equal'); ax[1].axis('off')
circ=plt.Circle((0,0),1.0,fill=False,color='#cbd5e0'); ax[1].add_patch(circ)
h=np.array([eis[a] for a in seg])
mx=np.sqrt((h*np.cos(ang)).sum()**2+(h*np.sin(ang)).sum()**2)
vx,vy=(h*np.cos(ang)).sum(),(h*np.sin(ang)).sum()
for i,(a,th) in enumerate(zip(seg,ang)):
    x,y=np.cos(th),np.sin(th)
    col = '#2f855a' if a in "AVILMFG" else ('#2b6cb0' if a in "KR" else ('#c53030' if a in "DE" else '#a0aec0'))
    ax[1].scatter([x],[y],s=460,color=col,zorder=3,edgecolor='k',linewidth=.5)
    ax[1].text(x,y,f"{a}{31+i}",ha='center',va='center',fontsize=7.5,color='w',fontweight='bold',zorder=4)
ax[1].arrow(0,0,vx/mx*0.62,vy/mx*0.62,width=0.025,color='#dd6b20',zorder=5,length_includes_head=True)
ax[1].text(vx/mx*0.72,vy/mx*0.72,f'$\\mu_H$ = {mx/len(seg):.2f}',color='#dd6b20',fontsize=11,fontweight='bold')
ax[1].set_xlim(-1.45,1.45); ax[1].set_ylim(-1.45,1.45)
ax[1].set_title('ADIRF residues 31-48 (VVDQATEAGQKAMDQLAK), helical wheel\ngreen = apolar, blue = Lys, red = Asp/Glu',fontsize=11)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
